svg.text: Page 1 of 3: Overview & Workflow · v0.13.0 · Claude Code Plugin
A Claude Code plugin that guides engineering teams through migrating legacy web apps to modern stacks,
one unit (page · component · service · endpoint) at a time — with full state tracking and git-safe parallelism.
Sources ▸ ASP.NET WebForms / MVC · Java JSP / Spring MVC · AngularJS 1.x · PHP Classic · ColdFusion · VBScript ASP
UI targets ▸ React · Vue 3 · Next.js · Svelte-Kit · Angular · Astro · Remix · Nuxt
API targets ▸ Express · FastAPI · Django · Spring Boot 3 · NestJS · .NET Minimal API · Ruby on Rails
✓ State shared via git — zero conflicts per unit · ✓ Gated: parity + security + quality · ✓ Every unit recoverable
✓ Drop 1 .md file to add a new framework — no plugin code changes needed
(state.json.status progresses monotonically — each skill enforces its precondition)
/rollback, /retry, /abandon available for recovery at any stage
USER REPO (state lives here, shared via git)
Loaded into Claude's context when the command runs — each enforces a precondition on state.json.status
legacy-analyzer (read-only) · unit-migrator (inline loop) · parity-reviewer (parity + security) · migration-critic (quality, advisory) · permanent-gotchas (catalog)
One .md per stack — detection signals, scaffold cmd, test runner, auth notes. Drop 1 file = add 1 stack.
heartbeat.mjs — bumps last_heartbeat on every Write
Skills load framework files on demand — /analyze loads source, /scaffold loads target-ui + target-api, unit-migrator loads both
11 REQUIRED sections — team fills in target stack, auth model, scope, constraints
